# EazyQQ

> Personal QQ AI Assistant Desktop Client & Headless Automation Platform.

EazyQQ is a desktop application and CLI toolchain built with Tauri v2, Rust, React 19, and TailwindCSS. It integrates the NapCatQQ (OneBot 11) protocol with local/cloud LLM inference (OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM) to provide autonomous message filtering, group summarization, document extraction, and headless AI agent integration.

## Key Capabilities
- **Desktop UI**: Modern dark-mode interface for rule dispatch, contact whitelists, sliding-window group summaries, and diagnostics.
- **Headless CLI (`eazyqq_cli`)**: Full terminal control without launching GUI (`eazyqq_cli health`, `chat`, `contacts`, `summary`, `diagnostics`, `mcp`).
- **MCP Server (`eazyqq_cli mcp`)**: Standard Model Context Protocol over stdio for external AI agents (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity).
- **Default-Deny Policy**: Zero persistence or processing of messages from non-whitelisted sessions.
- **Offline Diagnostics**: Self-implemented pure Rust ZIP container to export redacted diagnostics.
